title: UGC problem and solution
description: The PAS demo: open on the failure state with the product absent, agitate for no more than five seconds, turn, then demonstrate honestly and land on relief. The most reliable starting point for ecommerce and SaaS, and the format to default to when the brief does not name one. Covers the failure-state opening, how long agitation may run, the turn, the demonstration that has to be truthful, and the relief shot. Load with ugc-ad-foundations.
summary: The PAS demo. Open on the failure state, agitate briefly, turn, demonstrate honestly, land on relief.

requires.why: The failure and relief beats are a matched pair of stills.
Bring the user's own footage in before trimming it.
The turn lands on a line, said flatly.
The audio drop at the turn is half of what sells it.
The failure and relief frames have to read as the same place.

route.deliverable: A 10–45 second vertical ad: the pain, the product, the payoff
askFirst: What is the specific pain the viewer has right now?
What is the proof it works?

models.note: Prompt the pair together so geometry matches.
Tired, not performative, through the agitation.

triggers: ad that shows the problem then my product
before and after style ad for my app
make an ad about the pain point we solve
standard tiktok ad for my product
I don't know what format, just make me an ad
